The daily scrum, also known as the stand-up meeting, is a short, daily meeting that helps the team stay connected and coordinated. During this meeting, each participant quickly shares what they accomplished since the last daily scrum, what they expect to accomplish by the next daily scrum, and what obstacles are slowing them down. The meeting is held standing up to encourage brevity and is limited to no more than 15 minutes.

I mean what is a scrum master
response: A scrum master is a role in the Scrum framework who acts as a coach, guiding the team to higher levels of cohesiveness, self-organization, and performance. The scrum master is the team’s scrum expert and helps the team get the most value possible out of scrum. They facilitate scrum meetings, help the team understand and use the artifacts of scrum, and guide the team members toward a better understanding of their roles. The scrum master is not the team’s boss, but a peer with specific responsibilities.
